description_en: Queries the monitoring information about resource groups within an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 查询弹性模式集群版（新版）ADB集群的资源池监控信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-resource-pool-performance --db-cluster-id am-0000000000000000 --key AnalyticDB_RP_CPU --resource-pools TEST_POOL --start-time 2021-06-10T07:00Z --end-time 2021-06-10T07:01Z --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterResourcePoolPerformance

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The metrics of the resource group. You can enter multiple metrics at the same time to query the monitoring information. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). Valid values:

AnalyticDB_RP_CPU: the average CPU utilization. Unit: %.
AnalyticDB_RP_RT: the query response time (RT). Unit: milliseconds.
AnalyticDB_RP_QPS: the queries per second (QPS). The value of this parameter must be a numeric value.
AnalyticDB_RP_WaitTime: the query waiting time. Unit: milliseconds.
AnalyticDB_RP_OriginalNode: the number of basic nodes in the resource group.
AnalyticDB_RP_ActualNode: the number of scheduled nodes that are scaled out in the resource group.
AnalyticDB_RP_PlanNode: the number of scheduled nodes to be scaled out in the resource group.
AnalyticDB_RP_TotalNode: the total number of nodes in the resource group. Total number of nodes = Number of basic nodes + Number of scheduled nodes that are scaled out.



If you leave this parameter empty, the monitoring information about all metrics is returned.

For more information about scaling plans, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189507.html
parameters.help_zh:
资源池数据监控指标。允许同时输入多个指标进行查询，多个指标间用英文逗号（,）分隔。支持监控如下指标：
AnalyticDB_RP_CPU ：CPU平均使用率，单位：%。
AnalyticDB_RP_RT：查询响应时间（RT），单位：毫秒（ms）。
AnalyticDB_RP_QPS：每秒查询率（QPS），单位：数值。
AnalyticDB_RP_WaitTime：查询等待时间，单位：毫秒（ms）。
AnalyticDB_RP_OriginalNode：资源池基础节点数。
AnalyticDB_RP_ActualNode：资源池分时弹性实际弹出的节点数（即执行扩容计划时实际增加的节点数）。
AnalyticDB_RP_PlanNode：资源池分时弹性计划弹出的节点数。
AnalyticDB_RP_TotalNode：资源池拥有的总节点数，总节点数=基础节点数+分时弹性计划中实际生效的节点数。

若该参数留空，默认返回所有指标的监控数据详情。
更多关于资源池弹性计划的信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189507.html
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The names of the resource groups that you want to query. You can enter multiple names of resource groups. Separate multiple names with commas (,).



The value of this parameter is case-insensitive. For example, `USER_DEFAULT` and `user_default` specify the same resource group.

If you leave this parameter empty, the monitoring information about the `USER_DEFAULT` resource group is returned
parameters.help_zh:
目标资源池名称。允许同时输入多个资源池名称进行查询，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。

输入的资源池名称不区分大小写，例如`USER_DEFAULT`与`user_default`表示的是同一个资源池。
若该参数留空，将返回`USER_DEFAULT`即默认资源池的监控信息
parameters.name: resource_pools

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to monitor the resource group. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You can view only the monitoring information about the resource groups within the last two days
parameters.help_zh: 资源池数据监控开始时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 仅支持查看最近2天的资源池监控信息
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to monitor the resource group. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 资源池数据监控结束时间，结束时间需晚于开始时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time
